title: Backend Engineer Learning Roadmap
summary: A focused pathway to solidify fundamentals, master core backend skills, build a showcase portfolio, and prepare for job success. Each phase blends learning, hands‑on practice, and reflection.

phases.title: Foundations
phases.summary: Strengthen core programming and data fundamentals.

milestones.title: Deepen Python (or Go) fundamentals
milestones.outcome: Write clean, idiomatic code and debug confidently.

tasks.title: Read Python data structures chapter
tasks.description: Study lists, dicts, sets, and tuples in the official Python tutorial.

tasks.title: Implement a CLI todo app
tasks.description: Create a command‑line tool that adds, lists, and removes tasks, using functions and modules.

tasks.title: Debug the todo app with pdb
tasks.description: Set breakpoints, inspect variables, and step through code to fix a deliberate bug.

tasks.title: Write a summary of key language idioms
tasks.description: Reflect on three Python idioms you’ll use in future projects.

milestones.title: SQL and Data Modelling Basics
milestones.outcome: Design relational schemas and run queries against a database.

tasks.title: Complete SQL basics on freeCodeCamp
tasks.description: Follow the interactive lessons covering SELECT, WHERE, JOIN, and GROUP BY.

tasks.title: Model a blog database on paper
tasks.description: Sketch tables for users, posts, comments, and relationships, noting primary/foreign keys.

tasks.title: Create the schema in PostgreSQL
tasks.description: Write CREATE TABLE statements and populate with sample data using psql.

tasks.title: Run analytical queries
tasks.description: Write queries to count posts per user and find most commented articles.

tasks.title: Document lessons learned
tasks.description: Summarize three modeling pitfalls you avoided.

phases.title: Core Skills
phases.summary: Learn essential backend patterns and tools.

milestones.title: REST API Design
milestones.outcome: Design and document clean, versioned APIs.

tasks.title: Read RESTful API design guide on MDN
tasks.description: Focus on resources, verbs, status codes, and pagination.

tasks.title: Sketch API spec for a URL shortener
tasks.description: Define endpoints, request/response schemas, and error handling on paper.

tasks.title: Create OpenAPI spec with Swagger Editor
tasks.description: Translate the sketch into a YAML file and validate it online.

tasks.title: Review a public API spec
tasks.description: Pick GitHub's API, note good practices and areas for improvement.

milestones.title: Authentication & Authorization
milestones.outcome: Implement secure token‑based auth in services.

tasks.title: Watch OAuth 2.0 overview on YouTube (free channel)
tasks.description: Understand grant types, scopes, and token flow.

tasks.title: Add JWT login to the todo CLI
tasks.description: Generate a token on login and require it for protected commands.

tasks.title: Write unit tests for auth middleware
tasks.description: Assert that valid tokens pass and invalid ones are rejected.

tasks.title: Summarize security best practices
tasks.description: Reflect on password storage, token expiration, and revocation.

milestones.title: Caching and Queues
milestones.outcome: Integrate Redis caching and a background queue into services.

tasks.title: Read Redis quick start on redis.io
tasks.description: Learn basic commands and data types.

tasks.title: Cache recent blog posts in Redis
tasks.description: Add get/set logic around the posts endpoint using a Python Redis client.

tasks.title: Set up a simple Celery worker
tasks.description: Create a task that sends an email reminder and run it asynchronously.

tasks.title: Document trade‑offs of caching
tasks.description: Reflect on consistency, expiration, and cache‑aside patterns.

phases.title: Proof of Work
phases.summary: Build portfolio projects that showcase the skills.

milestones.title: REST API with Auth and Tests
milestones.outcome: A production‑ready API demonstrating authentication, CRUD, and test coverage.

tasks.title: Define API spec in OpenAPI
tasks.description: Create endpoints for users, items, and auth using Swagger Editor.

tasks.title: Implement API with FastAPI (Python)
tasks.description: Code routes, models, and JWT auth following the spec.

tasks.title: Write pytest suite covering all routes
tasks.description: Include success and failure cases for each endpoint.

tasks.title: Add Dockerfile and docker‑compose
tasks.description: Containerize the app with PostgreSQL and Redis services.

tasks.title: Publish repo on GitHub with README
tasks.description: Document setup steps, design decisions, and how to run tests.

milestones.title: URL Shortener with Analytics
milestones.outcome: A service that creates short links, tracks clicks, and exposes analytics via API.

tasks.title: Model short URL and click tables
tasks.description: Design schema for URLs, owners, and click events.

tasks.title: Implement shortening endpoint
tasks.description: Generate unique keys, store mapping, and return short URL.

tasks.title: Add click tracking middleware
tasks.description: Record each redirect in the analytics table.

tasks.title: Expose analytics endpoint with pagination
tasks.description: Return total clicks and per‑day breakdown for a given short URL.

tasks.title: Write integration tests using HTTPX
tasks.description: Validate end‑to‑end flow from creation to analytics retrieval.

milestones.title: Background Job Worker
milestones.outcome: A reliable worker processing queued tasks such as email sending or image resizing.

tasks.title: Design job schema and queue interface
tasks.description: Use PostgreSQL LISTEN/NOTIFY or Redis list for pending jobs.

tasks.title: Implement worker loop with graceful shutdown
tasks.description: Consume jobs, execute dummy work, and log results.

tasks.title: Add retry and dead‑letter handling
tasks.description: Track attempts and move failed jobs after max retries.

tasks.title: Create CLI to enqueue sample jobs
tasks.description: Allow users to submit jobs with parameters via command line.

tasks.title: Document architecture diagram
tasks.description: Explain how producer, queue, and worker interact.

phases.title: Getting Ready
phases.summary: Advance topics and prepare for job or freelance opportunities.

milestones.title: Performance Tuning and Monitoring
milestones.outcome: Identify bottlenecks and set up observability for services.

tasks.title: Read profiling guide on Python Docs
tasks.description: Learn cProfile and line‑profiler usage.

tasks.title: Profile the URL shortener API
tasks.description: Measure request latency and pinpoint slow database queries.

tasks.title: Add Prometheus metrics endpoint
tasks.description: Expose request counts, durations, and error rates.

tasks.title: Set up Grafana dashboard (free tier)
tasks.description: Visualize metrics and create alerts for high latency.

tasks.title: Write a brief post‑mortem of a simulated outage
tasks.description: Reflect on root cause, mitigation, and future safeguards.

milestones.title: Advanced Testing Strategies
milestones.outcome: Apply property‑based, contract, and load testing to ensure reliability.

tasks.title: Explore hypothesis library tutorial
tasks.description: Write property‑based tests for input validation functions.

tasks.title: Create contract tests with Pact
tasks.description: Define consumer expectations and verify provider compliance.

tasks.title: Run load test with k6 (free)
tasks.description: Simulate 1000 concurrent users against the auth endpoint and record results.

tasks.title: Document test coverage report
tasks.description: Generate an HTML report with coverage.py and summarize gaps.

tasks.title: Share test strategy on LinkedIn
tasks.description: Connect with peers and get feedback on your approach.

milestones.title: Job/Client Readiness
milestones.outcome: Present a polished portfolio and interview confidently.

tasks.title: Craft a one‑page technical summary
tasks.description: Highlight key projects, tech stack, and measurable impact.

tasks.title: Practice system design interview questions
tasks.description: Use free resources like Grokking the System Design Interview to outline solutions.

tasks.title: Mock a behavioral interview with a peer
tasks.description: Answer common questions and receive constructive feedback.

tasks.title: Set up a personal domain and deploy a project
tasks.description: Host one portfolio API on Render or Fly.io with HTTPS.

tasks.title: Write a reflection on next learning steps
tasks.description: Identify gaps and plan continued growth after landing a role.
